verified_facts.text: The resort is 40 minutes from Tucson International Airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits in the Sonoran Desert in a canyon setting.

verified_facts.text: The Golf Club at Dove Mountain has three nine-hole Jack Nicklaus Signature courses named Wild Burro, Saguaro and Tortolita.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Wild Burro, Saguaro, and Tortolita 9-hole courses at The Golf Club at Dove Mountain are a test for players of every level.

verified_facts.text: The Golf Club at Dove Mountain was for six years the home of the PGA Tour's WGC Accenture Match Play Championship.
verified_facts.excerpt: For six years The Golf Club at Dove Mountain was the home of the PGA Tour’s WGC Accenture Match Play Championship.

verified_facts.text: The family-friendly Aventura Pool has a water slide and is connected to a children's splash pad.

verified_facts.text: The spa's holistic treatments use indigenous gemstones to ease muscles and restore balance.
verified_facts.excerpt: treatments take a holistic approach to wellness. Indigenous gemstones ease muscles and restore balance and clear energy.

verified_facts.text: Turquesa Latin Grill looks over the resort's infinity edge swimming pool, and its name is Spanish for turquoise.
verified_facts.excerpt: Turquesa is Spanish for Turquoise, a reflection of the infinity edge swimming pool the restaurant looks over.

verified_facts.text: A Native American flautist plays traditional songs on Ignite's patio each day at sunset.

verified_facts.text: Cayton's Restaurant serves Territorial Ranch Cuisine including fire-kissed steaks and buttermilk quail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cayton’s Restaurant honors the spirit of the West with bold Territorial Ranch Cuisine—fire-kissed steaks, buttermilk quail

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids sessions for resort guests ages 5 through 12 focus on life in Southern Arizona.

verified_facts.text: Guests can reserve private or group guided hikes in the Sonoran Desert and Tortolita Preserve, such as a Cactus Discovery or Ancient Art Hike.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reserve a private or group guided hike tailored to your interests such as a Cactus Discovery or Ancient Art Hike.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers stargazing beneath a certified dark sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the evening, unwind beneath our certified dark sky where stargazing becomes a celestial experience.

verified_facts.text: The Casita Village offers Casita Suites and Private Casitas with spacious patios and panoramic canyon views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casita Village featuring Casita Suites, Private Casitas, spacious patios, and panoramic canyon views.

verified_facts.text: Rooms use indigenous textiles, natural materials and desert earth tones, with terraces that have canyon and mountain views.
